about.leadTitle: Building and testing systems that run before theory reaches the syllabus.
about.bio1: I started programming well before the syllabus got there: while class was on the theory, I had already broken, investigated, and rebuilt the practical at home. So I read the actual documentation, measure with latency profilers, and take nothing as good until I’ve seen it pass automated tests.
about.bio2: Today I’m in my second year of DAW at STUCOM Pelai, after completing SMR. Simultaneously, I work as a Software Developer Intern at Soterguard, delivering web and On-Premise systems using Docker, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL.
about.bio3: Models draft the bulk of the raw keystrokes. The other 10% is the true engineering craft: scoping the problem, designing immutable contracts, debugging AI edge cases, and deeply understanding every line that gets merged into main.
